conclusions: Every declared tiny pilot gate now passes in both fact modes. Passing thresholds does not mean all 84 answers are correct.
Full tested training/evaluation configuration fits one T4; representative probe and real trial are recorded, not a guarantee for other batches/longer contexts.
The successful tiny setup supports 1.7B as the working candidate for the next shared-pipeline stage, with 0.6B retained as engineering/control evidence.
Do not retroactively alter 0.6B results, mix adapters across model sizes or claim 0.6B inherently incapable.
Constructed rationales/composite targets are supervised; this does not independently prove unseen composition or broad reasoning utility.
No full-candidate acceptance, canonical full M1/M2, unlearning or benign recovery demonstrated yet.
